Method

Each metric is ranked among all coins that have it (0 = lowest, 100 = highest; for metrics where lower is better the scale is flipped). A category is the weighted mean of the metrics a coin has; missing metrics are skipped. The score is the weighted sum of the categories. Scores are relative to the other coins.

Educational information only, not investment advice. Passing the screening criteria is not a recommendation.
Data provided by CoinGecko, DefiLlama and GitHub.
